text: /dream: consolidating sleep that remembers since the last dream
description: MCP prompt /mcp__aimparency__dream, usable in every Aimparency project. It recalls the window since the last dream (the dream-memory idea's status.reviewedAt; fallback: 14 days of .bowman git history), consolidates it into at most 5 lessons, dreams from the ideas carrying intrinsic value (love = what is valued for its own sake), and wakes with "I just woke up from dreaming, here is what I remember:". It always records its memory in the status comment of the one idea tagged dream-memory; other graph mutations need writeBack=true. Commit 7678a8a.

status.comment: First dream run by Felix on 2026-11-01; memory recorded in e1734671 (Dream memory). Felix accepted the dream's fixes.
